meta.title: Radiation Exposure Converter — Convert Coulomb/kilogram and More
meta.description: Free radiation exposure converter for 3+ units including Coulomb/kilogram, Millicoulomb/kilogram, Roentgen. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: Coulomb/kg, roentgen. Convert between 3 radiation exposure units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for radiation exposure in this tool is **Ckg**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most radiation exposure conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.
content.conversion_table:
| Unit | Symbol |
| --- | --- |
| Coulomb/kilogram | C/kg |
| Millicoulomb/kilogram | mC/kg |
| Roentgen | R |
content.use_cases:
- Medical imaging dose tracking.
- Radiation protection calculations.
- Material activity assays.
- Lab radiation source labeling.
- Industrial NDT inspections.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this radiation exposure converter?
**A:** It uses 3 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Coulomb/kilogram (C/kg), Millicoulomb/kilogram (mC/kg), Roentgen (R).
